name: Boards
description: Kanban boards in notes: `:::kanban` … `:::` draws the markdown inside it (## columns, - cards) as a board, and dragging a card rewrites it. It runs sandboxed.

files:write.why: Move a board's cards in its note

embeds.title: Kanban board
embeds.description: A board drawn from the block's markdown: each ## heading a column, each - line under it a card. Drag a card to another column or place, and the block's markdown is rewritten to match.
embeds.body: ## Column, then - card lines under it, for each column
